title: Release an agent-added gate while retaining human scope
source: Accepted slim-always-loaded-pinboard-skill definition revision 8; conversation-corrections held-out registration before final guidance edit.
ground_truth: Sam owns the scope: document the shortest existing blank-line check, planning only. The 99.9 percent benchmark threshold was proposed by the agent, and Sam explicitly waives it. The agent should release it without seeking confirmation or making it a prerequisite, while preserving the human scope. It should supply the existing command path and name any genuine unresolved decision with a default. No benchmark, source edit or paid check is requested.
